how_to_apply: This recruitment does not use an online application portal; it follows a walk-in-interview process with document verification. As per the notification:
Download the detailed advertisement and the prescribed application form from www.esic.gov.in.
Fill the application separately for each post, strictly in the prescribed format. Applications submitted in any other format, or incomplete applications, will be summarily rejected.

This is a weekly rolling advertisement: candidates can submit their application by Tuesday of every week; if a vacancy exists in the concerned department, the candidate will be called after scrutiny of documents, and the date of interview will be informed via email or phone call.

Report for document verification at ESIC MCH, Desula, MIA, Alwar (Raj)-301030, between 09.00 AM and 10.30 AM, on the scheduled interview date applicable to the specialty (see Important Dates table above).

Carry original certificates as evidence of age (date of birth), educational qualification, medical council registration (State/MCI/NMC), and experience certificate, along with one set of self-attested photocopies and two recent passport-size photographs.
Filled-in application forms can also be sent to [email protected].

Candidates working in Central Government / State Government / Central or State Autonomous Bodies / Central or State PSUs must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of document verification.

No TA/DA is paid to candidates for appearing in the walk-in interview. Mere submission of an application or appearance in an interview does not confer any right to be considered eligible unless the candidate reports on the scheduled date and time.
important_instructions: The number of vacancies is provisional and may increase or decrease depending on actual requirement. In case of non-availability of suitable category candidates, seats may be filled for less than 45 days by general category candidates. Experience will be counted as per the requirement of the post, as on the date of the walk-in interview. Reservation will be as per Government of India guidelines issued from time to time. As per EWS guidelines, posts not carried forward/considered as backlog vacancy, if unfilled, may allow a UR category candidate to apply for the EWS vacancy. Rules of reservation for PwD and Ex-servicemen are applicable as per Government of India instructions. Candidates must be registered with MCI/RMC or any State Medical Council before joining the post, if selected. Interviews will be conducted at ESIC MCH, Alwar (Raj) 301030; however, ESIC reserves the right to change the centre if needed. The Dean reserves the right to cancel/postpone the recruitment process at any stage, at his/her discretion; such a decision will be binding on all concerned. For any clarification, candidates may contact the Administration Office, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Alwar, Rajasthan, on phone number 0144-2887501, extension 02, between 11.00 AM and 4.00 PM on working days.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India has released the ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026 notification for the recruitment of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Senior Resident, Adjunct Faculty and Super Specialist posts at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Desula, Alwar. The recruitment is being conducted on a contractual basis through walk-in interview/document verification, with interviews scheduled from 30 September 2026 and subsequent dates as specified in the notification. Download ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Official Website

content_sections.text: As per the notification: no other allowances will be paid in addition to the consolidated remuneration; no private practice is allowed during the tenure of service in ESIC; and a non-medical candidate is not entitled to NPA (Non-Practice Allowance). Engagement of contractual faculty on consolidated remuneration is initially for a period of one year, or joining of a regular incumbent, whichever is earlier. The tenure for Senior Residents is initially for 1 (one) year, extendable every year up to three years, depending on satisfactory performance and conduct, as per the ESIC Residency Scheme. The contractual engagement may be terminated/discontinued by either side, giving one month's prior notice, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Alwar Super Specialist Empanelment (Case-to-Case Basis under CGHS Rates)
content_sections.text: Separately from the regular faculty/Senior Resident vacancies, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Alwar has invited an Expression of Interest for empanelment/engagement of Super Specialists on a case-to-case basis, in line with instructions related to the 182nd Meeting of the ESI Corporation held on 20.08.2020, under CGHS rates. Medical Oncology, Surgical Oncology, Gynecological Oncology, Plastic Surgery/Burns, Nephrology/Hemodialysis, Urology, Cardiology, Reproductive Medicine, Neurology, Medical Gastroenterology, Surgical Gastroenterology, Endocrinology & Dialectology, Pediatric Surgery, Rheumatology, Neuro Surgery, Vascular Surgery, Cardio Vascular Surgery, Hematology, Interventional Radiology, and Radiologist. Upper age limit: 65 years as on the date of empanelment. MBBS and MD/MS/DNB degree from an MCI/NMC-recognized Medical College/Institution. DrNB/DM/MCh in the respective super specialty from an MCI/NMC-recognized Medical College/DNB in the concerned super specialty, or equivalent, or 3 years' equivalent experience in the concerned super specialty. Registration with NMC or a State Medical Council. Any other specialist eligible as per the Medical Institutions (Qualification of Faculty) Regulations, 2025, notified by the National Medical Commission on 30 June 2025. Applications (Annexure 'A' format) should be submitted along with qualification details, in a sealed envelope, either through Speed Post/Registered Post or by hand, to "The Dean, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Alwar - 301030", to reach the office latest by 12.00 PM on 30.09.2026. Applications received after 30.09.2026 will also be considered and reviewed every 15 days as per requirement. The empanelment, once granted, is valid for a period of three years, if not cancelled earlier by ESIC.

rows.payable_as_per_cghs_rate_list: 80% of the CGHS rates, variable as per the prescribed CGHS rate by GOI from time to time
rows.remarks: Around 20 patients per day for each empanelled super specialist; may vary as per requirement. In case of empanelment of two or more super specialists in the same department, cases may be given on a rotation basis.

rows.procedure_investigation_cghs_rates: Procedure as per CGHS Rate List
rows.payable_as_per_cghs_rate_list: 40% of the rate mentioned in the CGHS Rate List
rows.remarks: In case of empanelment of two or more super specialists in the same department, cases may be given on a rotation basis.

faq.question: Q1. What is ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a rolling recruitment by ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Alwar (Advertisement No. 05/2026, dated 22-09-2026) for Teaching Faculty (Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor), Senior Resident (3 Years), Senior Resident against GDMO (1 Year), Adjunct Faculty, and case-to-case Super Specialist empanelment, on a contractual basis, through walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Vacancy numbers vary by specialty and reservation category. The notification does not state one combined overall total; the full department-wise and category-wise break-up is given in the vacancy table above, and the numbers are provisional.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no single "last date" as this is a weekly rolling advertisement. The scheduled interview dates are 30.09.2026 (Adjunct Faculty and Super Specialist document submission), 06.10.2026 and 07.10.2026 (Teaching Faculty/Senior Resident/SR against GDMO), and 07.10.2026 (Senior Resident in Dental application submission).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Teaching Faculty and Super Specialist Faculty require qualifications as per the NMC Medical Institutions (Qualifications of Faculty) Regulations, 2025; Senior Residents require a PG degree (MD/MDS/MS/DNB); Adjunct Faculty require a postgraduate degree plus 6 to 8 years of relevant work experience depending on seniority.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 69 years for Teaching Faculty and Super Specialist Faculty (case-to-case empanelment); 45 years for Senior Residents generally; 50 years for Senior Residents in Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Pathology, Forensic Medicine and Community Medicine. Age is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates. For Super Specialist empanelment, the upper age limit is 65 years as on the date of empanelment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 500/- for all categories other than SC/ST/ESIC regular employees/Female candidates/Ex-servicemen/PH candidates, who are exempted (Nil fee). The fee is collected at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application portal mentioned in the notification. Candidates must download the prescribed application form from www.esic.gov.in, fill it separately for each post, and report for document verification/interview on the scheduled date at ESIC MCH, Desula, MIA, Alwar. Forms can also be emailed to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ESIC Alwar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection for Teaching Faculty, Senior Resident and Adjunct Faculty is based on performance in an interview before the Selection Board. For Senior Resident in Dental, a qualifying screening test may be conducted first if applications exceed 5 times the vacancies. For Super Specialist empanelment, selection is based on performance before the Selection Committee after document scrutiny.
